acceptedDeltas.summary: Require strain, h(lambda), absolute Ca target, measured peak Ca, Ca/stress timing, CaT50 and Ca-at-stress-peak fields.
Require source-stress to chamber-realized stress/pressure scale transfer checks without Tref rescaling or free gain.
Compare Phase 2B source twitch peak against Land 2017 intact-human reference/expected scale at the same lambda/Ca condition.
Recheck FWHM, time-to-peak, relaxation tau and Ca-to-stress delay after loaded single-chamber, partitioned coupling and closed-loop integration.
Reproduce legacy activeStress alternans and require SDIRK2/equivalent second-order reference before robust no-alternans interpretation.
Point readers away from the unqualified clean atrial elastance bridge default toward ADR-MYO-002 and Phase 5.5.

notes: This artifact documents plan deltas added in PR #166 and does not itself accept the new ADR or select a bridge candidate.
